Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Striped Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Brick Red
Colors: Brick Red
Materials: Recycled cotton
Recycled cotton makes this pillow cozy and casual. Woven yarn-dyed stripes offer a classic feel that blends with any style room. For a different look, flip it over to the solid flax-colored side with ribbed texture. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17"L x 17"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
